title: CC: Rideable Turtles
description: A CC: Tweaked addon for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge): ride turtles as a passenger and haul mobs with a turtle_seat peripheral.
body:
# CC: Rideable Turtles

**Hop on a turtle and ride along — or let your programs pick up and haul mobs around.**

CC: Rideable Turtles adds one thing to [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked): a
**seat** turtle upgrade. Saddle up a turtle and it becomes something you can actually ride,
and something your Lua code can use to move creatures from A to B.

---

## 🪑 Ride your turtles

Attach a **saddle** to any turtle and sit on it. Your turtle program drives; you're the
passenger. Because the rider is glued to the turtle's real animation, the ride is **perfectly
smooth** — no rubber-banding, no lag, no stutter — and it costs nothing when no one's aboard.

- Sit down: sneak + right-click with an empty hand.
- Get off: sneak, just like a boat.
- The saddle shows on top of the turtle.

## 🐄 Haul mobs with code

Give your turtles a job. The seat is also a **peripheral**, so programs can grab a mob in
front / above / below, carry it anywhere, and drop it off exactly where you want:

```lua
local seat = peripheral.find("turtle_seat")
seat.mountDown()        -- scoop up the mob beneath the turtle
-- ... fly it across the base ...
seat.dismount()         -- set it down in front
```

Build mob taxis, automated barns, sorting pens, arena loaders — whatever you can script.

## ✨ Features

- **Ride any turtle** with a saddle — normal or advanced.
- **Buttery-smooth movement** that tracks the turtle's animation client- and server-side.
- **`turtle_seat` peripheral**: `mount` / `mountUp` / `mountDown`, `dismount` / `dismountUp` /
  `dismountDown`, `hasRider`, `getRider`.
- **Pre-made Rideable Turtles** in the ComputerCraft creative tab.
- **Carry almost anything** — animals, monsters, villagers, even players.
- **Boss-safe**: bosses are excluded via a datapack-editable tag (`#c:bosses` supported), so
  modded bosses are easy to block too.
- **Configurable**: toggle programmatic mounting, player mounting, and whether captured mobs
  keep their AI.

## 🔧 For programmers

`peripheral.find("turtle_seat")` gives you the whole API. `getRider()` returns the rider's
type, name, and whether it's a player; the `mount`/`dismount` calls run as turtle actions and
return `true` or `false, reason`. Full example:
[pen_to_pen.lua](https://github.com/CptIdea/CC-Rideable/blob/main/examples/pen_to_pen.lua).

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- **NeoForge**
- **CC: Tweaked** (required)

---

*Source & docs: [github.com/CptIdea/CC-Rideable](https://github.com/CptIdea/CC-Rideable)*
